headline: ContentSpec Initialization and Functionality
what_breaks: deps/deps.go — relies on helpers for content processing
resources/page/permalinks.go — depends on ExtractTOC for navigation
why: This file is crucial for content rendering and manipulation in Hugo. Changes to the ContentSpec or its methods can affect a wide range of dependent files and functionalities.
checklist: Review changes to NewContentSpec for config dependencies
Check modifications to ExtractTOC for nav structure impacts
Ensure stripEmptyNav logic aligns with content expectations
